page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 12 physical cores and 12 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 48.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and relies on a KVM hypervisor. Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across most standard workloads. The server achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1257.0 and a multi-core score of 6091.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 13441.38. In memory bandwidth tests, it recorded 698.22 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, and 55.6 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. However, it exhibits weaker performance in specific areas, such as the Passmark CPU physics test (741.78) and the Passmark memory score (1777.75), which fall into the bottom 25% tier.

This server is suited for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving (7.8 GB/sec throughput), database operations (Passmark database score of 3402.78), and Redis SET operations (11.64 million operations/sec). It can handle light LLM inference tasks on small models, processing 755.34 prompt tokens per second on a 135M model, but performance degrades significantly on medium 7B models (6.99 tokens/sec for text generation). The absence of local storage and GPUs makes it less suitable for heavy storage-bound databases or intensive deep learning tasks, but its dedicated CPU allocation offers stable compute performance for standard application hosting, software compilation, and text processing.
